title: Monsters, guardians and bosses
summary: 78 monsters: regular monsters, the guardians that close each dungeon and a few bosses.

blocks.text: Normal : the monsters of the rooms. Elite : any normal monster can roll elite (bigger, ×2 XP, drops shards and sometimes an item). Guardian : the final fight of a dungeon; the dungeon theme decides which one. Boss : special fights (training, events).
blocks.html:
• Normal: the monsters of the rooms.
  • Elite: any normal monster can roll elite (bigger, ×2 XP, drops shards and sometimes an item).
  • Guardian: the final fight of a dungeon; the dungeon theme decides which one.
  • Boss: special fights (training, events).

blocks.text: The numbers on a monster page are its own base stats. In a rift they are multiplied by the rank of the rift (×1 at rank E up to ×21 HP at Nation, guardians up to ×55): see Dungeon formulas . The game has no elemental weaknesses or resistances.

blocks.text: A guardian has more phases the higher the rift rank (2 at rank E, up to 6 at Nation). It starts attacking faster after each one. Variants are rolled at the start of the dungeon: Standard, Enraged (faster below 50% HP) and Summoner (calls adds at 66% and 33%).

blocks.text: Monsters have no drop table of their own: drops depend on the source. Elites drop an item at 8%, chests have their own tiers and guardians pay the spoils reel . See the odds hub .

blocks.text: Some monsters are undiscovered : their pages are blurred and ask for your help. If you find one, complete the page and remove the Undiscovered tag.
